items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Art Tatum in comparison to current musicians, but the interviewee (Benny Waters) does not respond with any personal anecdote, relationship, or direct interaction with Art Tatum.

ctx.x: The greatest - it's not true that some guys over there can't play fantastic. But you can't, like for an appearance, the guys who are technique and so forth - they can't, you can't say they're better than Americans. I mean, 'cause a lot of the things that the guys are doing now with ego, Art Tatum was doing years ago. You see what I'm talkin' about, Phil?
